clips.caption:
Before he was the most famous martial artist alive, Bruce Lee was washing dishes in San Francisco.

He wrote something down first - a technique from a hundred-year-old book on self-hypnosis, used by Carnegie, Rockefeller, and over a hundred of the wealthiest men Napoleon Hill ever studied. Hill found they all had exactly one thing in common: not luck, not timing - the way they used their own mind, including the one part most people never train, the sixth sense, the ether.

The actual letter still exists, in his own handwriting.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the technique.
